caveats: Baseline years 1992-2002; +-5-day pool windows at the period edges extend to 1991-12-27 and 2003-01-05, which are the first/last baseline days whose SST values entered the thresholds/climatology (reported above). Source SST is stored as float32 kelvin (no scale/offset) and was cast to float64 for all computations. Sea cells = 3311 of 3600 (finite SST on all 92 target days); land cells are 0 in the mask. 2019 is a non-leap year, so day-of-year 60 (filled from days 59/61 before smoothing) is not used by the target period. Per-cell MHWs: runs of >=5 consecutive hot days (SST >= threshold, kelvin as stored), gaps of 1-2 non-hot days joined; regional events: maximal runs of days with at least one region sea cell inside a per-cell MHW.
